content:
Sam: Heads up — planning a rootless-layer cutover next week to shrink attack surface. Need alignment on keystore access, signing flow, and RBAC windows. Can folks weigh in?
Priya: +1. Do we have an owner for signing key rotation during the canary? who will hold the cosign/KMS perms?
Alex: Re: logging — if we rotate signing keys mid-canary we should preserve attestations. We need an audit-log retention override for the canary pods (48h) so SRE can debug.
Maya: Suggest ephemeral service account per canary batch (1 SA per 5 nodes). Only grant cosign:sign and keystore:get, no broad roles. Then revoke after each batch.
Sam: Good call. Priya can you draft the minimal IAM policy? Prefer principle of least privilege and keep KMS wrapping keys in a separate key ring.
Priya: Drafted quick IAM snippet, thoughts?
Priya: ```json
{
  "roles": [
    "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter",
    "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
  ],
  "resources": ["projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/inference-keys/cryptoKeys/signing"]
}
```
Alex: That looks fine, but we should avoid iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the same principal that holds KMS. Split responsibilities: a signing controller SA and a short-lived requester SA.
Maya: On audit logs — add a structured tag on logs from canary pods: `canary=rl-layers-2026` so we can filter quickly. Also add an alert if any cluster node hits >5 cosign failures in 10m.
sre-oncall: Maintenance window clash: we have node upgrades on Wednesday 02:00-05:00 UTC. Can we avoid canary during that slot? Oncall would prefer Tue/Wed evenings instead.
Sam: Ack. Let's avoid Wed 02-05 UTC. Proposed canary schedule: Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC and Thu 22:00-01:00 UTC. Priya/Maya confirm.
Priya: OK for Tue and Thu. I'll create the IAM PR and include exact role ARNs and a step to rotate the canary SA after batch #2.
Maya: I'll update the canary playbook with: ephemeral SA creation, keyring binding, cosign signing step, and fallback to previous base image on signature mismatch. Add the log tag + alert rule.
Sam: Who's taking on the rollback automation? we should auto-fail the rollout if >1 percent of requests error or if cosign validation fails on >=2 nodes.
Alex: I'll pair with Maya on rollback hooks. We'll add a preflight that verifies KMS access and performs a dry-sign test: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/.../signing` against a test artifact.
devops-bot: Deployment scheduled by Sam for Tue 2026-08-10T23:00:00Z (canary batch 1). Link: https://deployments.redwood.internal/3256789012
Priya: Noted, PR coming in ~2h. I'll add the audit retention override and a runbook section for key compromise (rotate signing key, re-sign artifacts, pause canary).
sre-oncall: I'll be available during both windows. If upgrades get bumped, ping this thread and we'll reschedule.
Sam: Thanks team. Quick checklist I want in the PR description: 1) IAM policy + least-priv SA 2) Audit retention tag + query 3) Canary SA lifecycle automation 4) Rollback triggers and hooks 5) Post-canary key revocation plan.
Priya: Will do. Scheduling a 30m sync if anything blocks — calendar invite: https://calendar.company/meet/abcd1234
Sam: Perfect. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and we execute the Tue canary. :thumbsup:
